```{r setup}
library(sppdata)
```

## About the Subnational Politics Project

The [Subnational Politics Project (SPP)](https://www.subnationalpolitics.com/)
provides harmonized subnational political data for Argentina, Brazil,
and Mexico.

The `sppdata` package facilitates access to six datasets covering
subnational political institutions, elections, and democracy.

## Available datasets

To explore the datasets available through the package:

```{r}
spp_datasets()
```


## Exploring variables

The package provides access to the SPP codebook, which documents
the variables included in each dataset.

You can explore variables directly in R without an internet connection:

```{r}
head(spp_codebook())

# Explore variables for a specific dataset
spp_codebook("SED")
```

The official PDF codebooks are also available for download.
Each version corresponds to a published release of the SPP datasets.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Download the official v1.0 codebook
spp_codebook(version = "v1.0", download = TRUE)

# Download the official v2.0 codebook
spp_codebook(version = "v2.0", download = TRUE)
```

## Downloading data

Use `spp_data()` to download datasets from the project's GitHub Releases.
Downloaded datasets are cached locally to avoid unnecessary downloads.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
sed <- spp_data("SED")

head(sed)
```

You can also request a specific published version:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
sed_v1 <- spp_data("SED", tag = "v1.0")
```

## Mapping subnational politics

SPP provides geographic boundaries for subnational units
in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico.

The boundaries can be downloaded from the SPP v2.0 release.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

url <- paste0(
  "https://github.com/guadag12/sppdata/releases/",
  "download/v2.0/map_subnational_units.geojson"
)

map_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")

download.file(url, map_file, mode = "wb")

map <- sf::st_read(map_file, quiet = TRUE)

ggplot(map) +
  geom_sf(fill = "#E9ECEF", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_void()
```

## Citing SPP data

The archival versions of the SPP datasets are hosted on
Harvard Dataverse.

Use `spp_citation()` to retrieve citation information and
DOIs for the datasets and codebook.

```{r}
spp_citation()
```

For additional information, visit the
[Subnational Politics Project website](https://www.subnationalpolitics.com/).
